backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing users, plans, invoices, events, and anonymous usage tracking with Stripe integration and admin-only analytics queries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing VAT-related feature specs, required files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of various frontend source files for reference or tooling.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documentation defining the required deployment slug, validation rules, and build-time enforcement.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and theme variables defining light/dark mode color tokens and global styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting page title and bootstrapping the frontend by loading main.tsx.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Deployment checklist covering build steps, verification, security checks, and success criteria for production release v5.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Smoke test guide outlining required checks for routes, authentication, Stripe, and console markers in production.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up root layout, routes, and theme provider using TanStack Router and next-themes.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides login/logout button using Internet Identity, handling auth state and errors.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Collects and validates invoice details, manages legal text, and warns about historical VAT rate changes.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays mandatory invoice field validation results with pass/fail indicators and alerts.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Renders invoice preview, handles saving, risk checks, PDF download, and usage limits.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Shows detailed risk assessment for invoice validity based on VAT law checks.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides main layout with header, navigation, footer, and event logging for the app.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Allows admins to configure Stripe settings via secure form with backend integration.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Triggers Stripe checkout session creation, logs events, and redirects users to the checkout URL.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: Modal shown when users hit free limits, logging an event and offering navigation to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Upgrade modal presenting Starter and Pro plans with feature lists and navigation to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Displays remaining monthly invoice quota for free users based on account plan data.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryTrans: Collects country-specific VAT inputs, computes rates, handles reverse charge logic, and proceeds to calculation.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryVatDe: Shows VAT rates and features for a selected country and continues to the calculator if configured.
frontend/src/components/vat/EuVatIntroSt: Country selection screen for the EU VAT calculator with basic configuration info.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Displays detailed and simplified VAT explanations with a Pro‑gated PDF export option.
Paywall dialog prompting users to upgrade to access VAT explanations, logging events and linking to upgrade.
Renders a horizontal stepper showing progress through steps with dynamic styling for completed, current, and pending steps.
frontend/src/components/vat/GlobalDiscla: Displays a global VAT disclaimer alert explaining that VAT results are estimates and not legal advice.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Validates B2B VAT ID inputs and displays check results for format, country match, and reverse‑charge eligibility.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Collects VAT calculation inputs including customer type, VAT ID, amounts, rates, and reverse‑charge options, logging events and advancing the flow.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Shows calculated VAT results, legal notes, reverse‑charge notices, and actions for invoice entry, explanations, and new calculations.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Defines app metadata and validates the deployment slug against allowed formatting rules.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: Fetches the user's account plan and usage from the backend, mapping backend plan types to frontend labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Tracks anonymous user daily usage via fingerprinting and provides helpers for incrementing and checking remaining free usage.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Creates a Stripe checkout session through the backend and validates the returned session URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Computes a daily fingerprint and country via IP detection, exposing availability and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Provides a log function that sends analytic events with fingerprint and country metadata using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login, stored identities, and status flags. Wraps AuthClient creation and exposes login, clear, and identity state.
Defines React Query hooks for listing invoices and downloading invoice PDFs/ZIPs/exports through the backend actor. Each hook performs authenticated invoice-related operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Tracks remaining monthly invoice quota based on the user's plan and exposes a mutation to save invoices. Invalidates relevant queries after saving.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Derives simple plan access flags (paid, pro, starter) from the current account plan. Provides quick checks for plan-dependent UI logic.
Detects and stores the browser's preferred language, normalized to a simple language code. Returns the language and an English check flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching the current user's profile and checking Stripe configuration. Handles actor availability and query loading states.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes plus invoice watermark styling and safe-width select behavior.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Exports constant core analytics event names and a type representing valid event names. Used for consistent event logging.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Performs best-effort country detection using ipapi.co without storing raw IPs. Returns country code and IP when available.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Builds and sends structured analytics events to the backend, including device type, page, timestamp, and metadata. Skips logging if no actor is available.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Computes a daily hashed fingerprint based on IP, user agent, and date, with caching to avoid recomputation. Uses Web Crypto SHA-256.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Generates full HTML for an invoice using input data, VAT results, translations, and legal text logic. Formats seller/customer data, dates, VAT labels, and dynamic content.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Returns default legal VAT text based on the VAT calculation scenario, including reverse charge and Kleinunternehmer cases.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Performs invoice risk checks like missing fields, reverse charge validation, VAT ID checks, and future date warnings. Produces risk and warning lists with pass/fail status.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates required invoice fields and returns which checks passed and which fields are missing.
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a production‑only console marker and exposes the marker string for testing.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic German‑to‑English translation using a fixed dictionary and a German‑text detection helper.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Defines VAT input/result types and functions for EU and Germany VAT calculation, including reverse‑charge and special cases.
frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts: Contains EU country VAT configuration data and helpers to retrieve country settings.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed human‑readable explanations for each VAT scenario based on calculation results.
Provides simplified, kid‑friendly explanations of VAT scenarios.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Stores historical German VAT rates and helpers to get current/historical rates and detect rate differences.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Re‑exports core VAT modules for easier importing.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Determines whether OSS rules apply for a transaction and provides the reason.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Defines system prompt and step-specific prompts guiding a Germany-focused VAT calculation and explanation flow.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates EU VAT IDs for reverse-charge eligibility and returns structured checks with an explanation.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRule: Defines VAT categories and computes country-specific reduced rates for DE, FR, IT, SE, and BE.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Implements multi-step VAT calculator flow handling inputs, VAT rate computation, and invoice preparation.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Lists invoices, supports selection, single/batch downloads, exports, and enforces plan-based access.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders marketing landing page with feature list, supported countries, and navigation to calculator.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays payment failure message with options to retry or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows payment success confirmation, logs event, refreshes plan data, and provides navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Renders the upgrade plans page, handles authentication, Stripe availability, and starting a checkout session for paid plans.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Provides a utility to trigger browser downloads for text or binary content using Blob and object URLs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, radius, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file describing VAT-related feature requirements, architecture notes, and existing functionality metadata.
